players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that the Cardinals will evaluate Love (ankle) again Monday to hone in on a return date for the running back, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

players.name: Carson Beck
players.summary: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Beck (back) won't practice Wednesday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Zachariah Branch
players.summary: Branch (hamstring) went through warmups during the media-viewing portion of Monday's unofficial practice session, Daniel Flick of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.summary: Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Henry was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice after being placed back in concussion protocol, but the running back is expected to be available for Sunday's game against the Texans, Cordell Woodland of 105.7 The Fan Baltimore reports.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.summary: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's contest against the Chiefs.

players.name: Tetairoa McMillan
players.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Wednesday that the Panthers are "optimistic" that McMillan (foot) will play Monday in Tampa Bay, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Roschon Johnson
players.summary: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out  for Thursday's game against the Lions.

players.name: Andrei Iosivas
players.summary: Iosivas (thumb) was downgraded to out for Monday's game against the Commanders, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.summary: Boston (toe) wasn't spotted at Wednesday's practice, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN reports.

players.name: Raheim Sanders
players.summary: The Browns designated Sanders (hip) for return from injured reserve Tuesday.

players.name: Jake Ferguson
players.summary: The Cowboys ruled Ferguson (knee/ankle) out for Thursday's game against the Eagles, Patrik Walker of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Jonathan Mingo
players.summary: Mingo (ankle) did not participate in practice Tuesday.

players.name: Tyler Badie
players.summary: The Broncos designated Badie (thumb) for return from injured reserve Tuesday, Susanna Weir of the team's official site reports.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.summary: Broncos head coach Sean Payton announced Tuesday that Dobbins has been suspended one game for conduct detrimental to the team, Chris Tomasson of The Denver Gazette reports.

players.name: Skyy Moore
players.summary: Moore (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Bo Melton
players.summary: Melton (thigh) is listed as questionable for Wednesday night's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.summary: The Packers list Jacobs (finger) as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Rams, Wes Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Luke Musgrave
players.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Saturday that he doesn't anticipate Musgrove (neck) returning from the PUP list this season, according to NFL reporter Jason B. Hirschhorn.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.summary: Harrison (hamstring) was at practice Wednesday, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle  reports.

players.name: Woody Marks
players.summary: Marks (concussion) was on the practice field Wednesday, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle  reports.

players.name: Brevin Jordan
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Kayshon Boutte
players.summary: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Drew Ogletree
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: When addressing the press Wednesday, Pierce (heel) noted that the offseason procedure he underwent this past March was done because he was dealing with heel pain that impacted his Achilles, Kevin Bowen of 107.5 The Fan Indianapolis reports.

players.name: Will Mallory
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Seth McGowan
players.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said that McGowan will miss some time after injuring his hamstring in Thursday's 26-3 loss to the Texans, Stephen Holder of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.summary: Tuten (ankle) wasn't spotted at Wednesday's practice,  Demetrius Harvey of the Florida Times Union reports.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.summary: Meyers was spotted working off to the side during Wednesday's practice, Demetrius Harvey of The Florida Times-Union reports.

players.name: Noah Gray
players.summary: Gray (ribs) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Bills.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.summary: The Chiefs ruled out Walker (groin) for Thursday's game against the Bills.

players.name: Jared Wiley
players.summary: The Chiefs placed Wiley (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.summary: Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) was on the field for Wednesday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Dareke Young
players.summary: Young (stinger) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against Denver.

players.name: Justin Herbert
players.summary: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said that Herbert (concussion) won't practice Wednesday, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Brenen Thompson
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.summary: Mitchell (back) has re-entered Sunday's game against the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Terrance Ferguson
players.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson (hamstring) won't be activated from injured reserve this season and will require surgery to address the ankle injury he aggravated in Week 3, Stu Jackson of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.summary: Adams (hamstring) has an "outside chance" to return from injured reserve for the Rams' Week 13 matchup with the Chiefs but is more likely to be activated around mid-December, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.summary: Nacua (knee/toe) is expected to be sidelined 4-to-5 months after undergoing surgery Tuesday to repair his right MCL, which means he won't be on track to return at any point during the playoffs, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jared Wayne
players.summary: questionable

players.name: Malik Willis
players.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that, at this time, surgery to address Willis' groin/core injury is not foreseen, Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Addison will be listed as a non-participant on Wednesday's injury report, Ben Goessling of the Minnesota Star Tribune reports.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.summary: questionable

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.summary: Brown (hamstring) didn't take part in practice Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.summary: The Patriots designated Doubs (shoulder) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.summary: For now, Maye -- who suffered a fractured right fibula during a Week 10 loss to the Lions -- remains on the Patriots' 53-man roster rather than injured reserve, with coach Mike Vrabel citing the "balance" the team is hoping to strike with regard to managing its remaining designated to return from IR slots, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Johnson is still undergoing further medical evaluation after injuring his hamstring during Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears, Ross Jackson of WWL-TV reports.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.summary: Likely (groin) was limited in practice Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

players.name: Isaiah Williams
players.summary: Williams (ribs) was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday's estimated practice report.

players.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
players.summary: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Cooper (ankle/hip) won't practice Wednesday and is considered day-to-day.

players.name: Dontayvion Wicks
players.summary: The Eagles placed Wicks (ankle/foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.summary: Pittman (foot) was listed as a full participant in Wednesday's practice,Alan Saunders of SteelersNow.com reports.

players.name: Ben Skowronek
players.summary: Skowronek (calf) did not practice Tuesday.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: San Francisco head coach Kyle Shanahan said Wednesday that Stribling (ankle) is likely at least "a couple weeks away" from returning to practice, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports. "I don't know. I mean, nothing's changed," Shanahan said, regarding a timeline for the rookie receiver.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.summary: Evans (Achilles) won't practice Wednesday, Harrison Rich of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.

players.name: Brock Purdy
players.summary: Purdy didn't practice Wednesday due to an ankle injury, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald reiterated that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) will start Sunday against the 49ers if the quarterback fares well during Wednesday's practice,  Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: George Holani
players.summary: The Seahawks placed Holani (knee) on injured reserve Monday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Jalen McMillan
players.summary: The Buccaneers designated McMillan (knee) for return from injured reserve Wednesday, Scott Smith of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.summary: Diggs was absent from Wednesday's practice and was excused, Ben Standig of The Team 980 reports.
